senses.gloss: m. (עִמְעֵם) obscuring or suppressing the law, irregular measure passed in an emergency.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 8:4:2">Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:8:4">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ</cite>, a. e. <he>מהלכות של ע׳</he> one of the regulations passed in an emergency contrary to the real law.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:8:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ויש ע׳ לאיסור</he> dare you pass a prohibitory measure contrary to law?; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:4:6">Y. Sabb. I, 3ᶜ</cite> bot. (also <cite ref="P00591"><he>עִימּוּם</he></cite>).
